build_mbop_builder: build an MBOPBuilder instance with MBOPConfig, MBOPLosses, and optional NestedMeanStd for normalization
create_ensemble_regressor_learner: create an ensemble regressor learner for world model, policy prior, or n-step return using Adam optimizer
make_mbop_learner: make an MBOPLearner from MBOPNetworks, losses, dataset, and ensemble regressor learner factories
make_mbop_actor: make an Actor from an ActorCore policy, PRNG key, and optional VariableSource for the MBOP agent
make_ensemble_actor_core_policy: make an ensemble actor core policy from MBOPNetworks, MPPI config, and environment spec for evaluation or training
